mandatory_findings.title: Specify a realizable relay/control-channel topology across the SDK-owned subprocess boundary

direct_evidence.observation: Independent host supervisor and raw relays are required; fixture barrier/ACK must use a separate inherited pipe/socketpair.
Python directly launches /runtime/python -I -S /profile/fixture-rpc.py CASE_ID; SDK source patches and monkeypatches are forbidden.
SDK creates stdin/stdout/stderr pipes itself and supplies neither pass_fds nor close_fds.
Actual local CPython defaults are close_fds=True and pass_fds=(); unrelated inherited descriptors are closed.
SDK spawn supplies env and signal, without extra stdio descriptors.

mandatory_findings.consequence: The driver cannot simply pre-open an extra control FD and expect either direct SDK child to receive it. The HOW also does not select where independent relays attach to the SDK-owned streams. SDKPY07's request/cancel/reply barrier and complete-capture cutpoints therefore depend on an unspecified transport construction.
mandatory_findings.required_change: One grouped T1 HOW repair: select and describe the process/channel topology for both clients, identifying adapter versus synthetic peer, relay and supervisor endpoints, and how control reaches them without modifying the SDK, mixing control into SDK stdout, or exposing ambient host sockets. A separately identified launch adapter creating its own peer/control FDs, or an explicitly confined per-attempt FIFO design, are possible approaches; the HOW must choose a coherent one. Keep concrete implementation and admission NOT_RUN, and require relay/barrier/EOF/truncation selftests before SDK import.
mandatory_findings.confidence_basis: Direct SDK launch AST inspection plus actual local CPython default/FD handling; this is a missing HOW construction, not an assertion that all alternative implementations are impossible.
mandatory_findings.validation_expected: R2 can review the revised topology statically. Later private driver qualification must witness both raw directions and the barrier, and reject missing/late/corrupt capture without SDK patches. No SDK/compiler execution is required to repair this finding.
